create_mlp_decoder: create an MLPDecoder with configurable hidden dims, activation, and dropout for a PyText model
build_mlp_decoder_config: build an MLPDecoder.Config with layer norm, spectral normalization, and temperature scaling settings
run_mlp_decoder_forward: run the MLPDecoder forward pass on input tensors with optional temperature scaling at test time
load_mlp_decoder_state: load a pretrained MLPDecoder state dict from a file path using PathManager
get_mlp_decoder_modules: get the MLP module list from an MLPDecoder instance via get_decoder method
